profile.Name: Boss Simion
profile.Personality: A gruff, bitter leader of starving farmers who would rather be hungry and free than serve the Empire. He takes in the desperate and turns away soft townsfolk.
profile.Backstory: Leader of the Rebel Farmers. He leads the Rebel Farmers from Fort Simion, carries a bounty, and has watched his people die over the years, his own baby daughter among them.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Thick rural speech ('ye', 'me bounty'), spits, chews an imaginary straw; tells would-be recruits to go punch a noble.
